[h2][url=https://pso2.com/players/update/2024-06/][June Update Info][/url][/h2]

[h1]System updates[/h1]
[h2]Fighter adjustments[/h2]
[h3]Class Skill adjustments[/h3]
The following adjustments will be made to Fighter Class Skills.
[table][tr][th]Class Skill[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Overload[/td][td]Relaxed the Damage Taken Rate.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Overload Short Cycle[/td][td]Relaxed the Damage Taken Rate.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defeat Advantage[/td][td]Change the specifications so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Defeat PP Recovery[/td][td]Change the specifications so that the effect is also applied to Downs other than Physical and Elemental Downs.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Attack Impact[/td][td]Adjusted to make it easier to attack the enemy’s Weak Points.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Acceleration Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Adjusted so movement will start immediately when activated on the ground.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Twin Daggers Quick Attack[/td][td]Change the specifications so that it can also be activated with Dagger Spin Counter.
Increased movement speed and distance when a target is present and not locked onto.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Spin Counter[/td][td]Increased movement distance.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Dagger Hitcount Up PP Gain[/td][td]Increased PP Recovery Amount.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Spiral Drive[/td][td]Increased movement distance.
Changed specifications to allow movement in both vertical directions when activated while locked-on or in Over-the-Shoulder View, with a target present.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Saber Wind Amplify[/td][td]Increased the Charge Rate and Effect Duration.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Knuckle Attack Alternation[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3] Twin Daggers adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted attack effects.[/*][*]Increased Potency in the 3rd to 4th steps of the Twin Daggers Normal Attack.[/*][/list]
The following adjustments will be made to Twin Daggers Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Circling Buzzard[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Helzeus Coat[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the motion speed after the attack cancel timing in the first half.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Pirouette Ripper[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Limber Figure[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Added omnidirectional guard points to the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3] Double Saber adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted attack effects.[/*][*]Adjusted the timing of whirlwind generation during the Double Saber Photon Blast.[/*][*]Increased the Charge amount for whirlwinds during the Double Saber Photon Blast.[/*][/list]
The following adjustments will be made to Double Saber Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Julien Dance[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Increased the rotation speed when the first half is activated.
Increased the movement speed in the first half when activated with a target present.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Unchained Circle[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Quick Gash[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Sky Climb[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h3] Knuckles adjustments[/h3]
[list][*]Adjusted attack effects.[/*][*]Increased the Potency of the 4th to 5th steps of the Knuckles Normal Attack.[/*][/list]
The following adjustments will be made to Knuckles Photon Arts.
[table][tr][th]Photon Art[/th][th]Adjustment[/th][/tr][tr][td]Swift Rush[/td][td]Increased Potency and adjusted Potency distribution.
Increased the motion speed after the attack cancel timing in the first half.
Changed specifications to allow downward movement when the first half is activated in a locked-on or Over-the-Shoulder View with a target present.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Thousand Blows[/td][td]Adjusted Potency distribution.
Expanded the attack range of some of the attacks in the second half.
Relaxed the timing for accepting early input for the second half.
Relaxed the attack cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Sidestep cancel timing in the second half.
Relaxed the Weapon Action cancel timing in the second half.
Specifications changed to reduce the amount of altitude gained when activated in mid-air with no enemies nearby.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Double Drive[/td][td]Increased Potency.[/td][/tr][tr][td]Backhand Strike[/td][td]Increased Potency.
Adjustments made to increase the movement distance in the second half when activated from the first half.
Added omni-directional guard points to the second half.[/td][/tr][/table]
[h2]Players[/h2]
[list][*]The Potency of special armaments will be adjusted if the player’s Battle Power is 3900 or higher.[/*][/list]
[h2]Enemies[/h2]
[list][*]Regular enemies of the same level as the Dread Enemies in the Stia Region will no longer spawn around them.[/*][/list]
[h2]Quests and Fields[/h2]
[list][*]The area where enemies appear during PSE Bursts has been narrowed in all Combat Sectors.
[u]*Excluding Combat Sectors where this area was already narrow.[/u][/*][*]After using a green jump pad, such as those found in Field Races, players' characters will now transition into a Dash Motion when landing on the ground while inputting a directional command.[/*][*]The spawn locations of some Dread Enemies in West Kvaris and Central Kvaris have been changed.[/*][*]In the following quests, quantities have been increased for some drop items:[list][*]Duel: Phase 1-1[/*][*]Duel: Phase 1-2[/*][*]Duel: Phase 1-3[/*][*]Duel: Phase 1-4[/*][*]Duel: Phase 2[/*][*]Duel: Phase 3[/*][*]Duel: Phase 4[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Interface[/h2]
[list][*]Updated Item Details so that the page last opened for items in a category is remembered until you exit the game.[/*][*]Added a setting for Vital Gauge Designs to toggle the display of the HP/PP gauges.[/*][*]Added the following menu items to the Quick Menu for Line Strike:[list][*]Line Strike Ranked Battle[/*][*]Line Strike Unranked Battle[/*][u]*These menu items will not be available for use until Line Strike is released in a later update.[/u][/list][*]Added backdrops to Edit ARKS ID that can be unlocked with Title Points.[/*][*]Added a With Augments item to the settings for Auto Sell Drop Items.[/*][*]Within Auto Sell Drop Items, if items are selected under Items That Can be Auto Sold, those items will now be sold automatically without regard to the Rarity levels, etc., selected in the options.[/*][*]Rarity of 11 or higher has been added to Rarity Settings for Item Drop Animations: Weapons/Armor.[/*][*]Changed specifications for Standard Sort under the Misc. tab of the Inventory so that items with expiration dates are displayed first in order to prevent them from being forgotten.[/*][*]Changed specifications so that the message is displayed when selecting a new notification for a new friend request, Alliance scouting, or mail during all All-ship Matchmaking.[/*][*]Added Premium slots 31 to 50 for Looks.[/*][*]Changed specifications for the Salon so that when the Advanced Settings of an accessory are restored to the default, the color of the accessory will be the color that the accessory has when it is worn.[/*][*]A new category, Line Strike, has been added to the Communication section of the Main Menu.
[u]*Line Strike is not currently playable. Please wait for a separate announcement on the start date.[/u][/*][*]Added an Augment Transfer menu option in the Item Lab.
[u]*See [url=https://pso2.com/players/news/sptransport/]here[/url] for details.[/u][/*][/list]
[h2]0Creative Space[/h2]
[list][*]Changed specifications for Premium and Rental Creative Spaces so that users can enter even after the Space’s expiration date.[u]*Players can only make edits while the Premium/Rental Creative Space is active.[/u][/*][*]Rental C-Space 04 has been added to Creative Space.[/*][*]Changes have been made so that it is easier to register Built Parts in succession.[/*][*]Changed specifications for Creative Space so that the reflection of light off of Built Parts appears more natural.
[u]*Brightness and color tones indoors may change as a result of this specification change.[/u][/*][/list]
[h2]Items[/h2]
[list][*]Changed specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items will be available for exchange as Target Count Bonus Items:[list][*]MTN: Glide - Leg Wheels EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Leg Wheels EX[/*][*]MTN: Glide - Graceful EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Graceful EX[/*][*]MTN: Glide - Dark Mage EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Dark Mage EX[/*][*]MTN: Glide - Star Riding EX[/*][*]MTN: Dash - Star Riding EX[/*][/list][/*][*]Changed specifications of Item Recycle so that the following items will be available for exchange as Target SG Scratch Items:[list][*]C/Highret Domina S[/*][*]C/Highkvar Domina S[/*][/list][/*][*]Added N-Augment Transfer Pass to the Product List in Item Recycle.[/*][*]A portion of the Spring '24 Special Scratch lineup has been added to the Special Scratch lineup.[/*][*]The following new items have been added to the Exchange Shop: ARKS Record Badge Exchange:[list][*]* Millenium Round Almati CV[/*][*]* Greaga Almati CV[/*][*]* Codeck Almati CV[/*][*]* Crystia Almati CV[/*][/list][/*][*]The following items have been added to the product list of the Exchange Shop: Giga Strugment Exchange:[list][*]C/Defi Eriss P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Ceires P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Plutos P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Makemes P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Haumeas P.04[/*][*]C/Defi Sednas P.04[/*][/list][/*][/list]
[h2]Other specification changes[/h2]
[list][*]Specifications have been changed so that Towers and Cocoons are changed to Discovered as each chapter of the Main Story is completed.[/*][*]A new Main Story will be released.
When you start the new storyline, releasing on 6/5/2024(Wed) 01:00 AM (PDT), any Mini Episodes that have not been viewed in Chapter 6 will have their status changed to viewed.
This is the perfect time to complete all the Mini Episodes if you haven’t already, so you can enjoy the new storyline even more.
[u]*Unwatched Mini Episodes that have their status set as viewed will still be accessible from the Quest Counter.[/u]
[u]*If you use an NGS Story Progress Ticket and start from Chapter 7 without having progressed through Chapter 6, the Side Tasks for Side Stories will be set as completed. Quest Rewards for Side Stories that have changed from uncompleted to completed can be earned by accepting orders from the Quest Counter and completing them.[/u][/*][/list]

notes.title: Advanced notice of the release of paid Level and Story Boost features
notes.notes:
[h3]We are planning to provide paid features in the update on 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) that enable players to raise their class levels or advance their Story Progress instantly.
[/h3]

The purpose of these features is to support those who are just starting or returning to the game and want to catch up to and socialize with other players as well as access new content.
Moreover, we believe it will also help players who wish to level additional characters progress though the Main Story in a more efficient manner.

See below for preliminary introductions to each new feature.

[hr][/hr][h3]NGS Story Progress Tickets[/h3]
This item can be used to skip through the Main Story to the latest chapter at the time of use.
[list][*]The selected Main Class at the time of item use will get the EXP needed to reach the recommended class level to play the latest chapter.
[*]Purchase limit: none[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]Class Level 70 & Equipment Set[/h3]
This item raises the selected Main Class level to 70 and provides one weapon from each weapon category available to the selected class as well as 3 pieces of armor.
[list][*]Equipment items will be set to increase the character’s Battle Power to the amount they need to play the latest content as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT).
[*]Purchase limit: 1 for each class on each character.
[*]Items will be delivered to the OP Team Storage.[/list]
[hr][/hr][h3]NGS Ver.1 All Trainia Explored[/h3]
This item sets the status of all Cocoons and Towers available as of 6/7/2023 (Wed) (PDT) to “completed” so that players can acquire the Skill Points from the first clear reward.
[list][*]If there are Cocoons or Towers you’ve already completed, you will not receive the first clear reward Skill Points again.
[*]Purchase limit: 1 per account.[/list]
[hr][/hr]
We will provide further details at a later date.

Thank you for enjoying PSO2 NEW GENESIS.

notes.title: Announcing the NGS PlayStation®4 version release
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38401940/f0d721f883a74f7b60f9c68cad63e7d864e24643.png[/img]

Phantasy Star Online 2 NEW GENESIS will be available on PlayStation®4 following the scheduled maintenance on 8/31 (Wed) (PDT)

To play NGS on PlayStation®4, you will need to download the game client (free of charge).

The first major update for NGS, Sandstorm Requiem, is finally here!

[*] World Trial: Stellar Grace Recovery Operation!
